# Cami

> Boutique booking software for independent yoga and fitness studios.

Cami is a booking platform built specifically for independent yoga, pilates, and fitness studios. It handles everything a boutique studio needs: class scheduling, online booking, membership management, clip cards, waitlists, and payments — without the complexity of enterprise tools.

## Who it's for

Independent studio owners who want a beautiful, simple booking experience for their members. Cami is designed for studios with 1–3 locations and a strong personal relationship with their community.

## What it does

- Class scheduling and booking (rolling 14-day window)
- Membership plans and clip cards with credit tracking
- Online payments via Stripe
- Waitlist management with automatic offer notifications
- Daily brief — a morning email to studio owners summarising member moments (first-timers, milestones, returns, expiring memberships)
- Studio management dashboard (attendance, check-in, client view)
